description: Read one public What Happened packet by story_id, normally copied from search_public_story_records. Returns the mapped public packet, source IDs, canonical URL and integrity information; it does not expose the private archive original. No authentication required. If the ID is unmapped or integrity validation fails, use the returned status and do not substitute a guessed ID.

story_id.description: Required public story_id from the catalog/search results (1–80 characters); private archive IDs are not accepted.

name: get_public_story_record
title: Read a Cassie Hour public record
